notes: «وساق أبو كريب الحديث بقصته نحو حديث ابن نمير» is a remark on another report, not a route; ابن نمير is not a link of this chain
«أبيه» is Hisham's father, a relation link; HKG completes it as عروة, which is not taken here
the saying is Aisha's own speech («قالت»)

fixes.reason: RWY places ابن نمير in the chain where the text writes أبو أسامة; ابن نمير appears in the text only in the variant remark.
